answer: A new identity must clear dunes of shale checks drawn from the oasis queue: the registry assigns past attestations at random for the applicant to re-verify, one shale check each, each verdict spot-checked against a hidden gold set, so one wrong verdict voids the whole dune. The k-th identity from one verified wallet costs k dunes, a dune is 100 shale checks at $2 each, and fresh checks are issued at mint time, so none stockpile. Forging 1,000 puppets from one wallet needs 100×(1+…+1,000)=50,050,000 checks, $100,100,000; an honest applicant clears one dune: 100 checks, $200.
